items.title: OCULUS maps for evaluating ortho-k: Epithelial Reshaping Power Map Learn how to obtain a more accurate evaluation of refractive change from ortho-k with the recently released map in the OCULUS Pentacam. Read Full Article
items.summary_es: OCULUS lanzó un nuevo mapa en el Pentacam para evaluar con mayor precisión los cambios refractivos inducidos por ortoqueratología mediante mapeo del poder de remodelación epitelial.

items.title: EssilorLuxottica at ARVO 2026: key insights in myopia research EssilorLuxottica brought new research advancements to ARVO 2026 on Essilor® Stellest® lenses and more. Here's what clinicians need to know. Read Full Article
